title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1991-04-05
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Baker, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns + Sennheiser 441's> Unknown Radio Shack Mixer > Sony D5,Tapes:Maxell MX 100's; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion With AudioGate V.3.0.2 To 32/96 kHz Wave; Dithered/Flacked With Korg Aqua To 16/44; SBE's Checked/Fixed With Trader's Little Helper; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Supreme Nak/441 matrix capture delivers a marathon second set with standout "The Other One" and "Wharf Rat" performances.
ai_review.review: This recording is praised as an outstanding, quad‑sounding mix that puts listeners right in the bowl at the Omni. The show itself is described as great, featuring loose, long jams and a second set that runs past the 100‑minute mark with highlights like "The Other One," a soaring "Wharf Rat," and a heartfelt "Not Fade Away."

ai_rating.rationale: Both the musical performance and the matrix recording are lauded as exceptional; the single detailed 5‑star review supports a high rating despite limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Nak mix combined with 441 mic captures quad sound; reviewers describe it as supreme, crisp, and immersive—ideal for headphones.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set stretches beyond 100 minutes with continuous energy, strong transitions and extended jams that keep the crowd engaged.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass work is highlighted as 'crunching' and 'pounding,' driving the performance especially on "The Other One."
